summary: Edge publication is crash-safe and forward-only: source-qualified staged builds are verified as one coherent unit through STAGING-LEDGER.sha256 before moving the tag and repairing fixed asset aliases. Interrupted publication converges on the next eligible run.

replay.detail: Release publication scripts only; no graph, claim or storage replay changes.

schema.detail: No daemon or client schema changes.

compatibility.detail: No client or daemon compatibility impact. Existing fixed-name archive URLs and per-archive checksum sidecars are preserved; STAGING-LEDGER.sha256 is a distinct temporary publication asset.

downtime.detail: No daemon downtime. During the documented brief window between moving the edge tag and replacing aliases, installers may receive the previous binaries; a mismatched archive and sidecar fails closed.

manual.detail: No operator step; an eligible subsequent publication repairs interruptions automatically.

recovery.detail: No data recovery or migration. A same-source or descendant publication repairs incomplete assets, cleanup and release notes.
